title: [podman-5.8] OCPBUGS-74172: storage: wait for tar-split completion to avoid reader race
body:

@QiWang19 I think you're doing `git cherry-pick {commitID}` for these backports.  If you can, please add the `-x` option to that command, ala: `git cherry-pick -x {commitID}`.  It leaves a few more breadcrumbs behind.
I double checked the commit message has  (cherry picked from commit 91633032...), same from the `cherryp-pick -x`
To be clear, the `-x` comment is for future reference; no need to redo these or others you've already put up for review, @QiWang19.
